UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,

Plaintiff,  v.  KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6,

Defendants. ____________________________________/

Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

[PROPOSED] ORDER

This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Notice of Subsequent Record Development Relevant to ECF Nos. 93 and 97–99 (ECF No. ___). Upon consideration of the Motion and for good cause shown, it is hereby

ORDERED that the Motion is GRANTED; and it is further

ORDERED that the Notice attached to the Motion as Exhibit A is DEEMED FILED as of the date of this Order and will be considered in connection with ECF Nos. 93 and 97–99.

The Clerk’s Office is directed to provide a copy of this Order to pro se Plaintiff at his last known address.

Alexandria, Virginia

__________, 2026

______________________________

Rossie D. Alston, Jr.

United States District Judge
